HOW IT WORKS You’ll crochet the pieces, shape each one over a latex balloon with fabric stiffener, sew them together and reinforce the joints with fabric stiffener again. The full process — shaping, stiffening & assembly — is shown in a video tutorial included with the pattern. WHAT’S INCLUDED ✔ Step-by-step written instructions ✔ Stitch charts ✔ Video tutorial (shaping, stiffening & assembly) ✔ Materials list + fabric stiffener recommendations & alternatives SKILLS NEEDED 🧶 Crochet — Confident Beginner / Intermediate 🪡 Sewing — Basic 🎈 Balloon twisting — no prior experience needed, a short YT tutorial beforehand is enough!
